word.sourceGloss: Words are the smallest meaningful pieces of a language that can be used on their own.
word.definition: A meaningful part of language that can be spoken or written on its own.

book.sourceGloss: A book is a lot of paper joined together with writing and pictures printed on them for you to read or write in.
book.definition: Pages joined together with writing or pictures for you to read.

door.sourceGloss: A piece of a wall that can be opened (leaving a hole in the wall to walk through) or closed (covering the hole). Some doors are on hinges; others slide.
door.definition: A part of a wall that opens and closes to let you walk through.

give.sourceGloss: If you give something to someone else, you had the thing and you let the other person have it. Maybe you use your hands to put the thing in the other person's hands. Usually after that, the thing is the other person's thing.
give.definition: To let another person have something that was yours.

better.sourceGloss: The comparative form of good; more good.
better.definition: Of higher quality, or more good than something else.

mountain.sourceGloss: A natural rise of the Earth's surface having considerable mass
mountain.definition: A very large, high part of the Earth's surface.

water.sourceGloss: Water is a clear liquid of the chemical compound H₂O that all living things need in order to live.
water.definition: A clear liquid that all living things need to live.

familiar.sourceGloss: If something is familiar, you already know it or about it.

solar.sourceGloss: If something is solar, it is of or related to the sun.

suspension.sourceGloss: A suspension is a temporary delay or interruption.

crystal.sourceGloss: A crystal is any solid that is made of atoms and molecules that are arranged in a neat pattern.
crystal.definition: A solid whose tiny particles are arranged in a neat pattern.

cucumber.sourceGloss: A cucumber is a vegetable that is grown on a vine.
cucumber.definition: A vegetable that grows on a vine.

crash.sourceGloss: A crash is a loud sound like a clang that happens when two things hit each other.
crash.definition: A loud sound made when two things hit each other.

gray.sourceGloss: One of the colors people can see. It is halfway between black and white.
gray.definition: The colour halfway between black and white.

happy.sourceGloss: When you feel happy, you feel good, usually because something nice has happened.
happy.definition: Feeling good, usually because something nice has happened.

watermelon.sourceGloss: A watermelon is a fruit. It is red on the inside and green on the outside. It contains a lot of juice.
watermelon.definition: A juicy fruit that is red inside and green outside.

model.sourceGloss: A model is a something that is made to look or act like something else, usually being smaller or simpler than the original.
model.definition: A smaller or simpler copy made to look or act like something else.

forgive.sourceGloss: When you forgive a person, you do not try to punish that person for something.
forgive.definition: To choose not to punish a person for something they did.
